description: SafeZone FIPS Cryptographic Module is a FIPS 140-2 Security Level 1 validated software cryptographic module from INSIDE Secure. This compact and portable module provides the most commonly needed cryptographic primitives for a large variety of applications, including but not limited to DAR, DRM, TLS, and VPN.
